clue.text: Branch of the deer family

parts.note: reads like a line of descent among deer, but the branch meant is the bony branching growth on a stag's head

explanation.definitionFit: A stag's horn divides into tines like the limbs of a tree, so it is literally a branch belonging to the deer.

clue.text: Is a name recollectable? Not with this

definitions.text: Is a name recollectable? Not with this

indicators.note: split as re-collectable, the letters can be gathered up again in a new order

explanation.surface: A question about whether a name can be remembered, answered with the condition that prevents it.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: rearranging ISANAME gives the condition in which a name cannot be recalled.
explanation.definitionFit: Memory loss is precisely the condition in which a name cannot be recalled, as the whole clue describes.

clue.text: Experience discrimination

definitions.meaning: to have a brief experience of something, as in to sample freedom
discerning judgement in matters of style and beauty

explanation.definitionFit: One can sample or try a thing, and someone with refined judgement in art shows good discernment; the word covers both.

clue.text: Give one the right name

definitions.meaning: to grant somebody a claim or entitlement
to give a book or work its title

explanation.surface: Someone being given the correct name.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to grant a person a claim and to give a work its title or name.

clue.text: Exhorted to be very topical?

parts.note: very topical means burning, current news; the joke is that the letters after the ex- of exhorted can be rearranged to make the phrase

explanation.definitionFit: News that is extremely current and exciting is described as burning hot, the colour of glowing metal.

clue.text: Wild anger over a point is still anger

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over the next one
wild suggests the letters of the word anger run out of control into a new order

parts.note: E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a wild outburst about a small matter is still just anger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wild' rearranges ANGER into ENRAG; 'over' puts it above E in this down entry. The definition is the verb 'anger', to make furious.
explanation.definitionFit: To infuriate someone is to make them angry, a straight synonym of the verb.

clue.text: Mum's dowry?

parts.note: Mum here is silence, as in keep mum, and the dowry is a payment made for it

explanation.definitionFit: Cash paid to buy someone's silence is the bribe for keeping mum, the joke being mum read as a mother.

clue.text: It is subject to negotiation by letter

definitions.text: It is subject to negotiation by letter

parts.words: It is subject to negotiation by letter
parts.note: a letter here is one who lets, a landlord, and the thing negotiated is the renting of a property

explanation.definitionFit: Occupying property as a renter is an arrangement agreed with the landlord who lets it.

clue.text: Act badly with impunity and leave in style

definitions.meaning: taken literally, to depart with flair or panache

explanation.surface: Someone who behaves badly, escapes punishment and makes a stylish exit.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means escaping punishment; read literally it describes departing with flair.

clue.text: Head denied extra payment for responsibility

indicators.note: the head, or first letter, of the word for extra payment is refused

parts.note: a bonus is an extra payment on top of wages

explanation.surface: A boss refused a bonus and given more responsibility instead.
explanation.definitionFit: A burden or duty that falls on someone is their responsibility.

clue.text: There's nothing in the insurrection leading to speculation

indicators.note: nothing goes in, placed within the phrase meaning the insurrection

parts.note: taken as written
a rising is a rebellion or insurrection
O looks like the figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A historian says the revolt contained nothing that leads to idle guesswork.
explanation.definitionFit: Forming ideas and hypotheses without proof is a form of speculation, here as a verbal noun.

clue.text: A hint of a rise

parts.note: a scent is a trace or hint, as when hounds follow a faint smell

explanation.surface: Just a slight suggestion of an increase.
explanation.definitionFit: A climb or upward slope is a rise.

clue.text: Words are not about to stick

indicators.note: about means going around, so the contraction encloses the other piece

parts.note: contracted to aren't
to gum is to stick with glue

explanation.surface: Someone insists that words do not stick.
explanation.definitionFit: Having words with someone is to quarrel, so words are a dispute.

clue.text: Retract support on quiet deal that's been arranged

parts.note: to back is to support
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

indicators.note: the word deal has its letters arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone withdraws backing for a quietly fixed deal.
explanation.definitionFit: To reverse a previous commitment or statement is to retract it, from pedalling a bicycle in reverse.

clue.text: Pretends to work as a taxidermist — it's easy

parts.note: to kid is to pretend or tease
a taxidermist stuffs dead animals

explanation.surface: A taxidermist's job is so simple it is child's play.
explanation.definitionFit: Something childishly simple is a thing that is very easy, so the phrase describes an easy task.

clue.text: Grudging admiration of diplomat with nothing to lose

indicators.note: the diplomat is made to lose a letter

parts.note: an envoy is a diplomatic messenger
O looks like the figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A penniless diplomat is regarded with grudging admiration.
explanation.definitionFit: Resentful longing for what another has is often described as grudging admiration.

clue.text: Such pomposity is not a front

definitions.meaning: a flank, as opposed to the front or back

explanation.definitionFit: Side is an old term for pompous airs; it also names a flank, which is not the front.

clue.text: Charge for keeping silver in a warehouse

indicators.note: keeping means holding something inside, so the warehouse holds the silver

parts.note: a store is a warehouse
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A fee for holding silver bullion in a depot.
explanation.definitionFit: The fee paid for keeping goods in a depot is called by the same name as the act of keeping.

clue.text: Score a single was the key to opening in the old days

definitions.text: the key to opening in the old days

parts.note: a score is twenty
a single is one

explanation.surface: A tally of runs that once unlocked something.
explanation.walkthrough: Coming of age was once at this birthday, when one was given 'the key of the door'.
explanation.definitionFit: Until 1970 British adulthood came at this age, celebrated as receiving the key of the door.

clue.text: Capital one invested in new casino

indicators.note: invested in means placed inside, so one goes inside the other letters
new signals that the word casino is remade with its letters in a fresh order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone puts money into a newly opened gambling house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges CASINO into NCOSIA, and 'invested in' places I within it.
explanation.definitionFit: This city is the capital of Cyprus.

clue.text: Close match in which one retires

parts.note: nigh means near or close
a tie is a match or game, as in a cup tie

explanation.surface: A tight game in which one player withdraws.
explanation.definitionFit: A nightgown is the garment one wears on retiring to bed.

clue.text: Bounds within which wines are stored

definitions.meaning: leaps or jumps, as in pole leaps

explanation.surface: Limits inside which wine is kept.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both leaps and cellars where wine is kept.

clue.text: Canst not be shaken?

indicators.note: the letters of the archaic phrase are shaken up into a new order

explanation.surface: An archaic challenge: can you not be shaken?
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue serves as definition too: something steadfast is one that cannot be shaken.
explanation.definitionFit: Something steadfast and unwavering is one that cannot be shaken.

clue.text: Prime object of care

definitions.meaning: to load or prime a gun or battery
a person in one's care, a ward

explanation.definitionFit: To load a weapon with powder is to prime it; a person in one's care is one's ward.

clue.text: Bill has to deliver bitter

parts.note: ac, account, is a bill
to rid is to deliver or free from something

explanation.surface: A bill that must be paid is a bitter pill.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp, pungent taste or smell is acrid, a near synonym for bitter.

clue.text: Irregular liaisons result in people being hurt

parts.note: casual means occasional or irregular
ties are links or connections

explanation.surface: A warning that occasional affairs end with people getting hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: Those injured or killed in an accident or battle are its victims, people hurt.

clue.text: Formal procedure correctly reported

indicators.note: reported means spoken out loud, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: right means correctly, as in guessed right

explanation.surface: A procedure that has been accurately recorded.
explanation.definitionFit: A ceremony carried out by fixed rules is a formal procedure.

clue.text: Mischievous, switch the file and remain quiet

indicators.note: switch means swap the letters of the word file around

parts.note: sh is the call to be quiet

explanation.surface: A naughty child is told to switch files and keep quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Like an elf, impish and prankish, so mischievous.

clue.text: Light vessel gets led astray

parts.note: a can is a container or vessel

indicators.note: astray means gone off course, so the letters of led wander into a new order

explanation.surface: A small boat is led off course.
explanation.definitionFit: A wax stick with a wick is a source of light.
